title: Pure Vaylantz
summary: Vaylantz cards with Senet Switch and generic staples. Vaylantz are Scale 1 Pendulums that summon themselves from the Pendulum Zone into the Main Monster Zone in the same column, then move sideways between zones. Each move triggers an effect: a search, a Fusion Summon, or taking one of their monsters and placing it as a Continuous Spell. Vaylantz Wars searches a Vaylantz Field Spell and Senet Switch. Each Field Spell places the other one in the opponent's Field Zone, which switches on its shared effects. Vaylantz Wakening places a Pendulum from the Deck, and Shinonome searches a Vaylantz Spell. Vaylantz Wave - Master Phase, the newest card, pumps your big Vaylantz or locks away one of their monsters whenever a monster moves. The Pendulum summons stop non-Vaylantz summons except from the Extra Deck.
